data.title: Logix and Apple agree limited technical cooperation

actions.description: Requests documentation, test machines and compatibility assistance for native Apple II FlexiBUS, disk interoperability and Logix video products.
Agrees to limited technical cooperation and compatibility assistance.

outcomes.description: Apple accepts Logix-funded native expansion as a way to increase installed Apple II utility, with separate branding/support and no requirement to adopt the full Logix platform; its own peripheral strategy continues.
